"""Spike helper: Codex agent that keeps the provider prefix in --model.

Harbor's Codex strips "openai/" from the model (model_name.split("/")[-1]), but the
orq router (/v3/router/responses) requires "provider/model". This subclass rewrites
the `--model` flag of the generated `codex exec` command back to the full id.
"""
from harbor.agents.installed.codex import Codex


class OrqCodex(Codex):
    async def exec_as_agent(self, environment, command, *args, **kwargs):
        if self.model_name and "codex exec" in command:
            bare = self.model_name.split("/")[-1]
            command = command.replace(
                f"--model {bare} ", f"--model {self.model_name} ", 1
            )
        return await super().exec_as_agent(environment, command, *args, **kwargs)
